items.name: Betnation turnkey sportsbook partnership
items.claim: Kambi Group plc agreed a multi-year partnership with Dutch online operator Betnation to deliver its comprehensive Turnkey Sportsbook solution in the regulated Netherlands market.
items.source_excerpt: Kambi Group plc agrees Turnkey Sportsbook partnership with Dutch online operator Betnation October 20, 2025 Multi-year agreement will see the home of premium sports betting solutions deliver its market-leading online sportsbook to Betnation in the regulated Netherlands market Kambi Group plc (“Kambi”), the home of premium sports betting solutions, has agreed a multi-year partnership with Dutch online operator Betnation to deliver its comprehensive Turnkey Sportsbook solution in the regulated Netherlands market.

notes: Stored web_doc from Kambi's own press release covers the October 2025 Betnation turnkey sportsbook partnership. Kambi has no SEC filings (Nasdaq First North Growth Market issuer), so this run cites only its own press releases; no RPO/backlog figure disclosed. A second Kambi web_doc on the PMU (France) partnership is also stored (data/web/9e1e6abf0518ab85.json) but was not needed to reach COMPLETE.
